مُنَابٌ pass. part. n. of 4, A person made to supply another's place; &c. (Msb.) ―
-b2- أَمْرُ مُنَابٌ فِيهِ An affair in which a person is made to supply another's place; in which a person is made to act in the place or stead of another person; or as another's substitute. (Msb.) See the verb.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
